pre_impl.existing_data: DQ-143 listed 17 shown C5 rows typed generic with no area key; chapter_scope already records the chapter as a place.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: The official layer's Leichhardt polygons were never loaded; only the south-of-Parramatta-Rd ones (Marrickville 2.26) were.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: No new mechanism: AREA_KEY_RULES, AREA_GATE_RULES, importer PROFILES and may-apply areas reused from #1423.
pre_impl.external_source_error: The layer or address service failing stops the build script; nothing is written from a partial read.

functions.name: leichhardt_c5_entertainment_precincts
functions.what: Keys the chapter's rows to the official precinct outline.
functions.output: v2_precinct_id set to the outline id
functions.if_none: A row outside the selector is untouched
functions.edge_cases: south of Parramatta Road stays Marrickville 2.26
functions.failure_mode: A wrong id would key rows to no outline, hiding them, never widening them

functions.name: run (outline gate)
functions.what: Before writing keys, checks every derived precinct id has a stored outline; otherwise writes nothing for that rule.
functions.input: the rule's pending keyed rows and dcp_precinct_boundaries
functions.output: keys written only when every outline exists
functions.if_none: Missing outline prints NO OUTLINE and FAIL-CLOSED; rows stay as they were
functions.edge_cases: Marrickville 2.26 with its outline still passes (23 already ok)
functions.failure_mode: A wrong outline id is caught here instead of hiding rows silently
